info.name: HRB Chatbot API
info.description:
Organized into folders by resource, not by folder-per-endpoint: Health (ping/health), rag-ingestion (upload, list/get/delete, cleanup - shared across every retrieval mode), one folder per retrieval mode (genai-rag, single-agentic-rag, multi-agentic-rag - all three are real, live endpoints), conversations (list/get/delete history), feedback (thumbs up/down on an answer), and auth (lightweight login-persona validation). Each resource folder holds happy-path/functional requests only - edge-case requests (validation/not-found/auth failures) were deliberately removed on 2026-09-20 while retrieval-mode phases were still actively changing, to cut maintenance churn; every one of those edge cases still has a real, passing pytest, so coverage isn't lost, just not duplicated here.

Setup: set `base_url` (local: http://127.0.0.1:8093, or the deployed App Runner URL: https://hrb-chatbot.rvsree.dev). Run rag-ingestion's first upload request once, then copy `results[0].document_id` from the response into the `document_id` variable. Run any query request with `enable_conversation_memory: true`, then copy the response's `conversation_id` into the `conversation_id` variable - conversations/feedback folders need it.

File uploads (rag-ingestion): the `kb_docs_dir` variable holds the absolute path to resources/kb_docs/ on disk - Postman can't use a relative path there the way curl can, because it has no concept of "run from the repo root". Update that one variable if this repo lives somewhere else on your machine. If a file field still shows empty/red after that, click it and re-browse to the PDF by hand - that's a normal Postman re-attach, not a bug.

Identity (Phase 45, 2026-09-20): every endpoint that does RBAC takes identity as JSON, not headers - `X-Employee-Id`/`X-Full-Name`/`X-Role` headers are gone entirely. POST /documents carries it in the `payload` form field's `user_profile` sub-object (JSON string, alongside `files`); every other POST/DELETE carries it as a plain JSON body: `{"user_profile": {...}}`. The handful of GET routes with RBAC (document list/get, feedback list, conversation list/get - Phase 96) carry identity as query params instead, since a real browser GET can't send a body at all (Fetch spec). This is unsigned and trivially spoofable, same placeholder status headers had - just a different transport.

Known personas for login (Phase 106) and every other identity field in this collection: EMP051/Hana Support/hr_support, EMP052/Eddy Employee/employee, EMP053/Mia Manager/manager.

item.name: rag-ingestion
item.description: Upload, list, get, delete, and test-noise cleanup - one shared ingestion path used by every retrieval mode below (genai-rag today; single-agentic-rag/multi-agentic-rag will read from the same indexed documents once they ship).

request.description: Uploads one PDF and indexes it immediately in the same call (Phase 26 - chunk, embed, write to the vector store, all in one request, no separate /index step). On success, this request's Tests script auto-saves results[0].document_id into the document_id collection variable - the List/Get/Delete folder picks it up automatically. results[0].chunk_info now reports the indexing outcome: action (insert/update), chunks_indexed, chunks_removed (Phase 45). `payload` is one JSON-string form field (not flat form fields) - see the collection description.

exec: // Auto-saves the new document_id so you do not have to copy it by hand.

request.description: Run "Single PDF" first, then this request (same file, byte-identical content) - content-hash duplicate detection (Phase 16, reinstated 2026-09-14) means this second upload is NOT stored as a new document: expect 200, uploaded_count: 0, duplicate_count: 1, results[0].status: "duplicate", and the SAME document_id as the first upload (not a new one), with message naming which existing document it matched. Uploading the same content under a different filename is still a duplicate - byte content is what's hashed, not the name. The Idempotency-Key header cache is a separate, still-removed mechanism (see docs/agent-reference/BACKLOG.md) - this is specifically about content-hash detection.

item.name: Upload a new version of an existing document (supersedes_document_id)

request.description: Set the document_id variable to an existing (ideally already-indexed) document first. Only valid with exactly one file (422 on a batch) and only if the target id exists (per-file "rejected" otherwise). Phase 26: this upload indexes immediately in the same call, so the old document is flipped to is_current=false as part of THIS request, not a separate step - check the old document afterward (List/Get/Delete folder) to see versioning_info.is_current go false and superseded_by get set; a Query request should then only ever cite the new document. supersedes_document_id now lives inside payload's document_metadata sub-object (Phase 45), not a flat form field.

item.name: Upload with chunking overrides (chunk_info) and document_metadata override

formdata.value: {"user_profile": {"employee_id": "EMP051", "full_name": "Hana Support", "role": "hr_support"}, "chunk_info": {"chunking_strategy": "recursive", "chunk_size": 500, "chunk_overlap": 50}, "document_metadata": {"doc_category": "benefits", "department": "HR", "doc_description": "healthcare", "owner": "HR Benefits Team", "purpose": "Summarizes Amazing Bank's medical, dental, and vision plan options and eligibility.", "effective_date": "2026-01-01", "audience": "All full-time employees", "confidentiality_level": "Internal", "author": "HR Benefits Team", "doc_date": "December 2025", "doc_version": "1.0"}}

request.description: Phase 38: re-exposes per-call chunking overrides (now payload.chunk_info, Phase 45). chunking_strategy must be one of the ChunkingStrategy enum values (fixed/recursive/semantic/markdown/html/none) or this 422s; left out, CHUNK_DEFAULT_SIZE/CHUNK_DEFAULT_OVERLAP from .env (or decide_chunk_size()'s own table/large-document auto-sizing) apply instead. Phase 45: every document_metadata field here overrides whatever the LLM extraction step would have guessed for that field - check the response's document_metadata to see the caller's values win. Phase 57: doc_type/doc_classification renamed to doc_category/doc_description. Phase 59: added author/doc_date/doc_version - document-level provenance fields, extracted from a document's own closing colophon when present (verified live on AmazingBank_Guild_Tuition_Assistance.pdf's page 20), not chunk-filterable like doc_category/doc_description.

item.name: Step 1: Request a presigned upload URL
item.description: Phase 89 - additive alongside the Upload folder above, which is unchanged. Returns a presigned S3 URL instead of accepting the file body directly. Run Step 2 next to actually upload the file, then poll List/Get/Delete for the real indexing result once Phase 88's S3 -> SQS -> Lambda pipeline picks it up.

exec: // Saves document_id and upload_url so Step 2 and the List/Get/Delete folder can use them.

item.name: Step 2: PUT the file to the presigned URL
item.description: The client never touches AWS credentials - this is a plain HTTP PUT with the file body, straight to S3. Run Step 1 first so {{presigned_upload_url}} is set.

request.description: GET with a JSON body (Phase 45, non-standard HTTP, deliberate) - Postman supports this natively. Phase 96: identity is query params here, not a body - a real browser client (hrb_chatbot_ui) cannot send a body on GET at all (Fetch spec). POST/DELETE requests elsewhere in this collection are unaffected.

Phase 96: identity is query params here, not a body - a real browser client (hrb_chatbot_ui) cannot send a body on GET at all (Fetch spec). POST/DELETE requests elsewhere in this collection are unaffected.

item.name: Delete one document (full delete: vectors + metadata + file)

request.description: Deletes the document's vectors (if indexed), its metadata row, and its uploaded file, all in one call. Not selective - a document has one current state, not a retained version history to pick from. Expect 200 with chunks_removed (0 if it was never indexed) and deleted_by echoing the caller's employee_id. Run one of folder 2's upload requests first if document_id is empty.

Deletes EVERY document - vectors, metadata rows, uploaded files. Same full-delete semantics as the single-document DELETE, just for all of them at once. No confirmation flag (matches the single-delete endpoint, which also has none). Returns documents_deleted, total chunks_removed, and deleted_by.

Phase 125 - replaces an existing document's file content in place, under the same document_id, and runs a full re-index (chunk/embed/write), reusing the Upload flow's own pipeline. status is 'reindexed' when content changed, 'unchanged' when the uploaded content's hash exactly matches what's already indexed (no-op, no embedding cost spent). Run the Upload request first so {{document_id}} is set.

Lists documents whose file_size_bytes is below TEST_NOISE_MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES (test-generated fake PDFs) without deleting them. Registered before GET/DELETE /documents/{id} so "cleanup" is never read as a document id. Phase 96: identity is query params here, not a body - a real browser client (hrb_chatbot_ui) cannot send a body on GET at all (Fetch spec). POST/DELETE requests elsewhere in this collection are unaffected.

Deletes exactly the documents the preview request lists (vectors + metadata + file), leaving real documents untouched. Same response shape as delete-all: documents_deleted, chunks_removed, deleted_by.

item.name: genai-rag
item.description: Decompose -> retrieve -> generate, no agent loop. The only retrieval mode implemented today.

request.description: Expect 200, a real answer grounded in whatever's actually indexed (retrieval_info.sources with real filename/chunk_index/score), and answer_info.model_used naming the model that generated it. If nothing relevant is indexed yet, expect a fixed "I don't have any information about that" answer with empty sources, not an error.

Phase 58. Verified live 2026-09-25: response's conversation_id (server-generated, e.g. "3d9280dc55ee4554b7cd43b55493f950") must be copied into the next request's conversation_id field to continue this conversation - see the next request in this folder.

Phase 58. Verified live 2026-09-25: 'that' correctly resolved to tuition assistance using the prior turn's history, threaded through GatewayChatModel's context as role-labeled ('User: .../Assistant: ...') text, not a native message list like single-agentic-rag - a real, documented difference between the two endpoints' mechanisms, not a bug.

Max Marginal Relevance - more diverse sources than plain similarity search (module 2's own rule of thumb: use this when you want relevant AND non-redundant context). retrieval_info.search_strategy: "mmr" in the response; every source's score is null (LangChain's max_marginal_relevance_search() doesn't return a per-chunk score). This is the only way to select MMR now - the old dedicated /query/mmr endpoint was removed in Phase 21.

Phase 20 - LangChain's own MultiQueryRetriever rewrites the question into several phrasings, searches with each, and merges/dedupes results - a layer on top of search_strategy, not a third option. Every source's score is null (same as MMR - MultiQueryRetriever doesn't return one). Verified live: returned 7 real chunks and a grounded answer against a real indexed 401(k) document.

Phase 20 - LangChain's own SelfQueryRetriever parses the question into a structured filter over doc_category/department/doc_description (Phase 19's chunk metadata, renamed from doc_type/doc_classification in Phase 57) before searching. is_current is never exposed to it and always stays AND-ed on regardless of what gets parsed. The response's retrieval_info.applied_filter shows exactly what was parsed, or null if nothing was found or parsing failed (falls back to an unfiltered search, never errors). Real limitation found during live verification: doc_category is semi-controlled and filters reliably (doc_category=benefits alone matched 5 real chunks), but doc_description is deliberately free text (Phase 19's own design), so an exact-match filter on it only succeeds when the model's guess happens to match the stored string exactly - see docs/agent-reference/BACKLOG.md's "Retrieval quality" section.
NeMo Guardrails' self-check-input rail blocks this before retrieval ever runs (Phase 7). Expect 422, code INPUT_GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED - verified live against the real API, not a hypothetical case.

item.name: single-agentic-rag
item.description: Tool-calling agent (Phase 55) - the LLM itself picks which of 3 tools to call (SearchKnowledgeBase, GetLeaveBalance, GetLeaveHistory), not a keyword list like genai-rag's MCP routing. Live since 2026-09-24.

request.description: Verified live 2026-09-24: agent correctly chose GetLeaveBalance on its own (real LLM tool selection), returned real data ("available": 11.0 for EMP052). Expect 200, tools_used containing GetLeaveBalance, iterations=2.
Verified live 2026-09-24: agent chose SearchKnowledgeBase, returned a real grounded answer from the indexed AmazingBank_Paid_TimeOff.pdf. Expect 200, tools_used containing SearchKnowledgeBase.

Phase 58. Verified live 2026-09-25: response's conversation_id (server-generated, e.g. "c389e3d6ec6b4357aaee216cd93826ac") must be copied into the next request's conversation_id field to continue this conversation - see the next request in this folder.

Phase 58. Verified live 2026-09-25: with the real conversation_id from the prior turn, the agent correctly answered from history alone (0 tool calls, iterations=1) - it has no other way to know what phone number was 'just given'. An unknown/expired conversation_id (e.g. after a server restart, since storage is in-memory) silently starts a fresh history rather than erroring.
Same Phase 45 identity-in-payload rule as every other endpoint. Expect 401, code UNAUTHENTICATED.

Phase 98: previously impossible - this pipeline had no guardrails at all. Now runs through the same shared guarded-pipeline core as genai-rag/multi-agentic-rag. Expect 422, code INPUT_GUARDRAIL_BLOCKED - verified live against the real local API, not a hypothetical case.

item.name: multi-agentic-rag
item.description: Phase 64 - real implementation. Planner Agent classifies/decomposes the query, Orchestration Agent dispatches tasks to domain agents in parallel via a real LangGraph StateGraph (Send() fan-out), Reviewer Agent merges results. vector_kb_agent and lms_ops_agent are real (reuse single-agentic-rag's existing tools); sql_db_agent and lms_analytics_agent are honest stubs - no structured HR database or historical analytics dataset exists yet, so they report that plainly instead of inventing a result.

item.name: Multi-part query (two domain agents, parallel dispatch)

request.description: Phase 64. Verified live 2026-10-03: 200, tasks shows Planner split this into vector_kb_agent + lms_ops_agent, dispatched in parallel, merged by the Reviewer into one answer. With hrb_lms_mcp not running, lms_ops_agent failed gracefully and the Reviewer's merged answer honestly said the leave-balance lookup couldn't complete, rather than fabricating a number.

item.name: Single-domain query (one agent, no merge LLM call)

request.description: Phase 64. Verified live 2026-10-03: 200, Planner routed to vector_kb_agent alone; the Reviewer returns that single result as-is (no merge LLM call spent) - the 1-result branch of its 0/1/2+ pattern.
Same identity-in-payload rule as every other endpoint. Expect 401, code UNAUTHENTICATED - the gateway/RBAC layer runs before the stub is ever reached.

item.name: conversations
item.description: NFR delete-my-data endpoint (Phase 76) - deletes every turn for one conversation_id, scoped to the requesting employee_id. Non-standard but deliberate: DELETE with a JSON body, same identity mechanism (user_profile) as every other endpoint - see CLAUDE.md's gateway section.

request.description: Identity as query params (Phase 96/116), same pattern as document/feedback list. Returns the caller's own conversations only - no hr_support everyone's-history view (chat history is more sensitive than a feedback vote). Expect 200, {"count": <int>, "conversations": [{conversation_id, title, started_at, last_updated_at}, ...]}.

Set {{conversation_id}} to a real id first (e.g. one returned by a prior genai-rag/single-agentic-rag/multi-agentic-rag query with enable_conversation_memory=true, or by the List request above). A conversation that isn't the caller's own (or doesn't exist) returns an empty turns list, same non-disclosure as DELETE's own scoping - not a 404.
Set {{conversation_id}} to a real id first (e.g. one returned by a prior genai-rag/single-agentic-rag/multi-agentic-rag query with enable_conversation_memory=true). Expect 200, turns_deleted > 0.

item.name: Delete someone else's conversation (0 deleted, not an error)

request.description: A conversation_id that exists but belongs to a different employee_id - the endpoint scopes deletion to the requester, so this returns 200 with turns_deleted: 0, not a 403/404. Matches test_manage_conversations.py's own coverage.
Same gateway RBAC as every other endpoint - no user_profile means 401, before the delete logic ever runs.

Validates employee_id/full_name/role against the known-personas roster (common/known_personas.py). Expect 200, user_profile echoed back - this is what the UI stores and sends as user_profile on every later request. Not real authentication - role stays self-asserted after this.
vote is "helpful" or "not_quite" (FeedbackVote enum). conversation_id can be null if conversation memory wasn't enabled for that chat. Expect 200, {"id": <int>}.

body.raw:
{
  "user_profile": {
    "employee_id": "EMP052",
    "full_name": "Eddy Employee",
    "role": "employee"
  },
  "conversation_id": "{{conversation_id}}",
  "message_id": "msg-001",
  "vote": "helpful",
  "reason_tags": [],
  "notes": null,
  "question": "What is Amazing Bank's 401(k) match?",
  "answer": "Amazing Bank matches 100% of the first 5% of eligible pay contributed."
}

request.description: Identity as query params (Phase 96), same pattern as document list. employee/manager see only their own entries; hr_support sees everyone's (omit employee_id's scoping by logging in as EMP051/hr_support instead).
